oidcc-unsigned-request-object-supported-.reason: The provider rejects request objects with request_not_supported (OIDC Core 1.0 s6.1, permitted behaviour); the suite fires 'test skipped' because request objects cannot be exercised against such a server. Implementing JAR would flip this to a real PASS.

oidcc-scope-address.reason: address scope not advertised in discovery; provider does not return address claims.

oidcc-scope-phone.reason: phone scope not advertised in discovery; provider does not return phone claims.

oidcc-scope-all.reason: depends on address/phone scopes which the provider does not implement.
